notes.title: New upcoming game - Breeding Visa
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/ad1afbcfa106fb1660df1553ca668f000b3c7d9a.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3785660/Breeding_Visa/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/3f2fe354a1fbd398640e2f71b3a848cd1c15027a.png[/img]

[h1]Sex. Sex is always needed.[/h1]

A nation once known for its traditions and technological marvels thrived, its cities buzzing with life and its streets filled with busy crowds. Bullet trains sliced through misty mountains, neon-lit cities hummed with robotic servers, and engineers built AI companions fluent in a dozen languages.

But sex is always needed.

Over decades, people stopped connecting. Romance faded into memory. Dating apps shut down. Birth rates flatlined. Sex became a rumour, a half-remembered chore from a bygone era. By the year 2042, the silence grew deafening: an entire generation had forgotten how to want, how to touch, how to fuck. The government's answer was as radical as it was crude. The [i][b]Breeding Visa[/b] Program[/i]: a last-ditch program inviting foreign men to step into the void. No one pretended it was elegant. Locals weren't lining up for romance - they'd buried that instinct years ago. The task fell to outsiders: penetrate the apathy, spark desire where none existed, and plant the seeds of survival.

You are part of this awkward experiment. Your qualifications? A pulse, working anatomy, and the patience to teach what's been erased. The women here aren't shy. They're oblivious. Flirting? Foreplay? The missionary position? Lost knowledge, like hieroglyphics. Your job isn't just to fuck - it's to reboot a cultural libido from scratch. It won't be pretty. Expect blank stares when you unzip. Confusion over where things go. Women who'd rather binge streaming dramas than grind against a stranger. But the government's counting on you. Incentives are offered. And beneath the awkwardness? A flicker of curiosity. Maybe even hunger. The clock's ticking. Seduce a society that's forgotten how to feel. Or watch a civilisation fade into virginity.

Your life is about to change.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/ded825268af44a35b9c48a63ca065f42df056ca5.png[/img]

[h1]You Are the Catalyst[/h1]

Armed with a controversial past and an assertive personality, you’ll pursue reluctant women across a society obsessed with work and devoid of passion. Break through their apathy using any means necessary, persuasion, manipulation, or sheer dominance. Your visa depends on results.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/1adc528b9aef5d641ce7e43f21629d30b074904b.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Experience[/h1]

[i]Breeding Visa[/i] delivers a classic choice-driven visual novel with deep narrative branching

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/87b7403f87bd187a6d423c3b713ecb03a9b80684.png[/img]

[h1]Key Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [u][b]Seduction[/b][/u]: Target distinct women like the icy bureaucrat Yumiko, the rigid landlady Sakura, the anxious clerk Ami, and the hostile lifeguard Rin. Overcome their unique hangups through dialogue choices and escalating encounters.

[*] [u][b]Explicit Consequences[/b][/u]: Your choices lead to graphic scenes of exhibitionism, steamy encounters, and raw sex.

[*] [u][b]Save or Doom a Nation[/b][/u]: Your success determines this nation's survival. Will you spark a sexual revolution or watch civilisation fade into sterile oblivion?

[*] [u][b]Branching Paths[/b][/u]: Virginity, pregnancy, or societal collapse hinge on your strategy.

[*] [u][b]Uncompromising Adult Content[/b][/u]: Features uncensored sex, nudity, and adult themes.
[/list]

notes.title: Seducing My Elf Family now available
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that [b]Seducing My Elf Family[/b] is now available on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458860/Seducing_My_Elf_Family

[i]Twenty years ago, your father disappeared without a trace, leaving you and your mother to pick up the pieces. For two decades, there was no word, no sign of him - until he suddenly reappeared with a new family. He had started a life in another world, taking an elven wife and fathering two half-elf daughters, your half-sisters.

Tragically, he died not long after his return, leaving you alone to navigate life with this new and unexpected family. Your life was already strange enough, living with an elven step-mother and two half-elf sisters, but one day, a magical debt collector shows up at your door with the worst news possible. Your father’s unfinished business isn’t just about money, it’s about your family. And now, unless you can pull off the impossible, they’re about to be taken away forever.

You have a short time to form bonds stronger than the magical covenant that binds them. But let’s be honest, this isn’t about bonding over family dinners. You’ll have to seduce your elven step-mother and sisters, breaking through their defenses, exploring every intimate secret and perhaps appreciating the sensual charm of delicate elven feet. It’s a race against time, a battle of charm and forbidden passion, and an adventure unlike anything you’ve faced before. This visual novel delivers a unique mix of storytelling and seductive encounters.[/i]

notes.title: Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex is now released
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There's Sex[/b] has left early access and is now in full release!

[i]In a world ravaged by chaos and despair, you take on the role of a rugged survivor, braving the dangers of a desolate landscape overrun by raiders, mutants, and sinister factions vying for control. But amidst the ruins, a glimmer of hope emerges when you rescue a woman from the clutches of marauders, igniting a passionate partnership forged in the fires of adversity.

Together, you'll navigate the treacherous terrain of moral ambiguity, confronting ethical dilemmas that challenge your principles and test the limits of your humanity. Will you succumb to the darkness that lurks within, or will you rise above the chaos to become a beacon of hope in a world on the brink of oblivion?[/i]

The game's story, characters, and endings are fully complete, with all content polished and expanded based on your feedback during Early Access.

While the core game is complete, I’ll still monitor feedback for critical bugs or balancing issues. If something feels off, let me know via reviews or the discussion board.

That’s all for now. Time to see how your choices play out in the finished wasteland.

JellyFluff

notes.title: 4th content update released
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce the release of a new content update for [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b].

This update continues the storyline from the previous update. There are new locations, new characters, new scenes, and a slightly modified gallery. A few sound effects have been added to earlier scenes. 

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, typos, or continuity errors. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Content Update Released (3rd)
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the release of a new content update for [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b].

This update continues the storyline from the previous update. There are four new adult scenes in total - three of them are located within the new story content, and one is an addition to previous content. Some scenes are only available if certain past choices were made.

Without specific spoilers, I received some feedback about an earlier scene, specifically not liking the addition of a second male character in a scene, so I have included an additional option to that scene. You can see which scene I am referring to in the replay gallery.

Since the cast of characters is increasing I have included a disclaimer at the beginning of the game if you happen to pick a name associated with an existing character. It's new code that I've mostly tested but please advise if it causes any issues.

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, or typos. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Second Content Update Released
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the release of a new content update for [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b].

This update continues the storyline and mostly contains existing characters and settings (though there may be a surprise guest showing up depending on earlier choices). The choices that are made will have an impact in this update and you won't be able to see all the scenes in a single playthrough, unless you rollback of course. This update may seem shorter or longer to some people due to this.

There's a couple of stats that I'm still trying to balance, and am considering adding new ones, so be sure to leave feedback if anything feels too easy or hard to achieve. Also there's a large number of variables to keep track of so hopefully I've made the correct conditionals, but if anything doesn't seem to make sense let me know so I can fix it.

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, or typos. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Content Update Released
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the release of a new content update for [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b]. The update continues the story where it left off, and introduces a number of new characters and settings. 

While this update does contain several new adult scenes and achievements, some people may feel there is less of a focus on erotic elements this update. I wanted to properly introduce the new characters and environment firstly before focusing on that aspect of it. Rest assured that the next update will have a stronger focus on adult situations.

If I have tested it correctly then your existing save games should work, and if you've saved your game during the ending credits then it should revert back to the last scene, after which the game should continue as per normal. If there's any issues, let me know, but the game is still in Early Access so you may have to load an earlier save.

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, or typos. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: We did it! Why is reaching 10 reviews so important?
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has left a review for [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b] so far. Getting to 10 reviews is the first milestone that I am aiming for. The first 10 reviews are very important as there is a big visibility boost by Steam when that number is reached (ideally positive). I'm hoping that we get there. It has to be from paying players though - curators and free keys do not count. 


https://howtomarketagame.com/2022/01/25/why-your-first-10-reviews-are-the-most-important/


In other news I have completed considerable work on the next content update for the game. You will find yourself in a new community, where you will have to decide whether to help them or control them. You may even meet someone you weren't expecting to. That update will be released as soon as it is ready.

That's all I have for now. Thank you.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Upcoming release information
notes.content:
[b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b] is scheduled to release into Early Access in a little over a week. The Early Access build has been uploaded and approved, which means the planned release date should be met.

The story has been continued from the demo, with much more dialogue, scenes, and animations. Additionally, the dialogue from the demo has been changed, and there is an additional animation. If you played the demo, I recommend starting again due to the changed dialogue, the additional animation, and the ability to get the achievements. This means the demo has been deactivated as it no longer accurately represents the state of the project.

As this game will be released as Early Access, there will be added content provided in the form of updates over the coming months. It also means that some content is subject to change depending on feedback. As I have previously mentioned, I have been adding screenshots showing snippets of the added content, so have a look if you're interested.

That's all I have for now. Thanks.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex Demo
notes.content:
This is a quick note to advise that there is now a demo version of [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b] available for download. The demo version will allow you to play a small part of the beginning of the story in order to get an idea for the type of game that it is and to gather some initial feedback.

The initial early access version is not due for a couple of months so it may change significantly from the demo. The early access version will have more content than what is contained in the demo, and of course the final version is still a while away. This is the first time I've released a demo on Steam so hopefully it works correctly. The demo may be removed when the early access version is released - I am undecided right now.

For the demo version there are no achievements available, so expect to have to start a new game when the final version is released. It's possible you may be able to use the same save file but it won't be tested.

Let me know if there are any bugs or provide any feedback you have. Thanks.

That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex
notes.content:
I am happy to announce my new upcoming game titled [b]Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex[/b]. As its name suggests it is set in a post-apocalyptic world with all the chaos, danger, and excitement that comes with it. You will be expected to make decisions that will determine who lives and who dies.

Now that I have a much improved graphics card I can fully render all the scenes in the game rather than use sprites. Adult scenes will be properly and fully animated.

The game is currently in early access, which means that it is not finished yet, and I will be adding more content to the story over time. Due to the ambitious nature of the project I didn't think I would be able to release it all at once without iterations along the way. Please feel free to leave feedback/suggestions after each update. 

The initial release is in a couple of months. After that I will be releasing periodic content updates until I feel the game is in a completed state.

That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff
